newsitem.title: USA: Man dies in Ford plant shooting.
newsitem.headline: Man dies in Ford plant shooting.

text.p: A man who was shot by a gunman in military fatigues at a Ford Motor Co. assembly plant Thursday has died, police said.
Police said the heavily armed gunman gave up voluntarily after a tense, four and a half-hour standoff.

Sgt. Clarence Goodlein of the Wixom police said the white male shot and killed one Ford employee and wounded another, then left the plant and shot an Oakland County Sheriff's deputy in the shoulder when police tried to confront him.
Goodlein did not identify the victims, but a Ford worker, Jim Maher, said the man killed was a foreman at the plant.

Deputy Matt Miller, 39, was listed in stable condition and was expected to undergo surgery Thursday afternoon, said Amy Middleton, a spokeswoman for Providence Park Medical Center. The other wonded man was treated at the hospital and released.
